title: Scientists discover how pancreatic cancer rewrites its DNA to escape treatment
caption:
Pancreatic cancer is notoriously difficult to treat because it constantly adapts. A new study analyzed nearly half a million individual tumor cells to see how they change their genetic makeup to evade therapy. The results point to potential new targets for future treatments.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover how pancreatic cancer rewrites its DNA to escape treatment

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261024221849.htm
